snippet.title: Red Season – Official Trailer | 2026 UPCOMING DEMO #horrorgame  #indiegame  #newgame #indiehorror
snippet.description:
A brutal father’s revenge starts now!

Wishlist Red Season on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4083140/Red_Season/

Red Season is a stealth-action horror game where you play a father hunting down a violent rural cult to rescue his kidnapped daughter. Experience visceral melee combat, brutal takedowns, and psychological tension inspired by Manhunt and The Last of Us.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4083140/Red_Season/
X (Twitter) – Dev Updates: https://x.com/GameDevFromRed
Voice Over: https://bobbytaorminavo.com/
Music: https://fedecardi.bandcamp.com/
